Extremely disappointing
May 2026 • Couples
🤦‍♂️🤦‍♂️ As an Italian, I genuinely don’t understand how this place could have a 4.9-star rating from nearly 2,000 reviews on Google and over 1,000 on TripAdvisor This is nowhere near what I would consider an authentic Italian restaurant.
Don’t let the reviews convince you to come here. The place felt dirty, the food was barely acceptable, and there was nothing on the menu that came close to real Italian cuisine. As someone who grew up with Italian food, this experience was honestly disappointing.
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this restaurant simply does not deserve the reputation its rating suggests.
I am also disappointed to see Cardi promoting this place. In my opinion, they should be more careful about the venues they choose to endorse. Likewise, I would encourage TripAdvisor to regularly verify that ratings accurately reflect the customer experience, because based on my visit, the score shown here is difficult to understand.

Snack near the market
Jul 2025 • Solo
While walking through the local bazaar, I got very hungry and decided to stop by a restaurant nearby. From the outside, it looked pretty decent and the feedback was good, so the expectations were positive. There are two floors inside, the female staff are friendly, but there were no guests at all. I went up to the second floor, sat at the table and got the menu. It turned out to be pretty shabby - I didn't want to touch it with my hands, which immediately confused me a little bit. European cuisine and steaks are on the menu, prices are high. I didn't dare experiment, so I took pizza and beer. The waiter had to wait a long time because the staff was mostly on the ground floor. While I was waiting, I looked in the bathroom - everything looked tired, the doors weren't closing well. Beer had to be reminded on its own, too, as it was forgotten. The pizza arrived about half an hour later: small and not the most presentable, but tasted normal, especially when very hungry. The service left a mixed impression - on the back. The place doesn't match their prices at all, and it's a mystery how they get so many good reviews.
